messages:
sam: Quick sync — token-cost attribution sprint update. Short: schema PR ready, need owners for validation and a rollout window.

olivia: Thanks Sam. I can drive schema review this week. 

min-jun: I can take the ingestion & QA side. Do we have a sample of the new event payload?

sam: Pasted below — this is the minimal event we'll emit from the serving runtime. Want to keep it compact to avoid cost blowups.

sam: ```json
{
  "event_type": "inference.token_cost",
  "model": "redwood-v1",
  "request_id": "<uuid>",
  "tokens_in": 34,
  "tokens_out": 142,
  "batch_size": 1,
  "cost_usd": 0.0043,
  "latency_ms": 78,
  "timestamp": "2026-03-12T14:23:45Z"
}
```

esther: Nice, can we also include a field for routing variant? e.g., "variant": "quantized" so we can attribute cost diff.

sam: Good call. I'll add variant and a shallow `meta` map for future tags (no heavy objects).

min-jun: For ingestion: we plan to backfill last 7 days. Any concerns with cardinality from request_id?

olivia: request_id is fine. We should avoid user PII in events — confirm serving runtime strips prompt text.

sam: Serving runtime emits only token counts and hashes; no prompt/response bodies. We've verified with security.

analytics-bot: deploy pending: infra-checks passed, feature-flag off, will mark when rollout starts.

sam: Rollout plan proposal: merge schema PR Tues EOD, feature flag on in staging Wed, two-day smoke, then gradual prod ramp Thu-Fri. Owners: schema review = olivia, ingestion + backfill = min-jun, dashboards = esther. Can we lock that? :calendar: 

olivia: Locking it. I'll do review Tue morning. PTAs: check token rounding and currency conversion in cost_usd.

esther: I'll create the initial cost-per-route dashboard and a latency breakdown per model/variant. Need the final event field names to wire queries.

min-jun: For backfill I need the sample SQL to populate aggregated table. Proposed:

min-jun: ```sql
INSERT INTO analytics.token_cost_agg(date, model, variant, tokens_in, tokens_out, cost_usd, avg_latency_ms)
SELECT date_trunc('day', timestamp) as date, model, variant, sum(tokens_in), sum(tokens_out), sum(cost_usd), avg(latency_ms)
FROM raw.events
WHERE event_type = 'inference.token_cost' AND timestamp >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY 1,2,3;
```

sam: Looks good. Add DISTINCT request_id check to dedupe in case of replays.

min-jun: Will add dedupe step.

olivia: One more ask: can we emit a latency_bucket field (e.g., <50, 50-200, >200) so charts render faster?

sam: We can compute buckets at ingest to avoid expensive aggregation. I'll add latency_bucket with values "lt_50", "50_200", "gt_200".

deploy-bot: staging rollout started by sam at 2026-03-16T09:12:03Z. Flag: token_cost_v2 = off -> on (staging).

esther: I'll wait for final event names then wire up dashboard panels. ETA Thu morning.

olivia: I'll do a quick cross-check against cost attribution tests — ping me when staging data is available. :+1:

sam: Thanks everyone. Action items tracked in the PR and the project board. If no blockers, merge Tue and start staged rollout Wed.

min-jun: Noted. I'll prepare the backfill job and smoke tests.

analytics-bot: prod ramp scheduled: earliest Thu 2026-03-18 subject to staging smoke pass.

sam: closing loop — anyone else to add as an owner?

olivia: Nope from me.

esther: All good.

sam: great — will post final PR link here when ready. :rocket:
